result.instructions: Tools for Shopmonkey, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the shop's work orders with their status and assigned technicians."; "Which vehicles has Jane Smith brought in, and what was done?"; "What appointments are on the calendar for tomorrow?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shopmonkey data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shopmonkey_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shopmonkey_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shopmonkey_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. shopmonkey_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shopmonkey_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the user this API key acts as — id, name, company, default location and permissions. A cheap way to confirm the key works and to find your locationId. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/user/me.

tools.name: shopmonkey_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Search customers with a server-side filter, sort and paging. Returns customers with their emails and phone numbers. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/customer/search.

where.description: Filter object applied server-side, keyed by field name, e.g. {"lastName": "Smith"} or {"createdDate": {"gte": "2026-01-01"}}.

orderBy.description: Sort instructions keyed by field name, e.g. {"createdDate": "desc"}.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_find_customers_by_phone
tools.title: Find customers by phone number
tools.description: Find the customers that own any of the given phone numbers — the usual way to identify a caller. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/customer/phone_number/search.

excludeCustomerId.description: A customer id to leave out of the results.

tools.name: shopmonkey_find_customers_by_email
tools.title: Find customers by email
tools.description: Find the customers that own any of the given email addresses. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/customer/email/search.

excludeCustomerId.description: A customer id to leave out of the results.

tools.name: shopmonkey_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by id — contact details, emails, phone numbers, counts of vehicles/orders/appointments. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/customer/:id.

tools.name: shopmonkey_list_customer_vehicles
tools.title: List a customer's vehicles
tools.description: List the vehicles owned by a customer (year/make/model, VIN, plate, mileage). Shopmonkey: GET /v3/customer/:id/vehicle.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_list_customer_orders
tools.title: List a customer's orders
tools.description: List a customer's work orders (estimates, repair orders, invoices) — their service history. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/customer/:id/order.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_get_vehicle
tools.title: Get one vehicle
tools.description: Fetch a single vehicle by id, including its mileage and tire-pressure logs. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/vehicle/:id.

tools.name: shopmonkey_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List work orders for the shop, paged. Each order carries its number, status flags (authorized, invoiced, paid), totals in cents, workflow status and assigned technicians. For one customer's orders use shopmonkey_list_customer_orders. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/order.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: Fetch a single work order by id — customer, vehicle, complaint, totals (parts/labor/tax in cents), payment state and profitability. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/order/:id.

tools.name: shopmonkey_find_order_by_number
tools.title: Find an order by its number
tools.description: Find a work order by the number the shop sees (e.g. 1042 or #1042), also matching an overridden external number. Tries Shopmonkey's server-side filter first, then reads the order list page by page (newest first) and compares each number exactly, up to maxOrders orders. Returns the order (use its id with the other order tools) or found: false with how many orders were read. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/order.

number.description: The order number as shown in Shopmonkey, e.g. 1042 or "#1042".

maxOrders.description: How many orders to read at most when the filter finds nothing. Default 1000.

annotations.title: Find an order by its number

tools.name: shopmonkey_list_order_services
tools.title: List an order's services
tools.description: List the services (jobs) on a work order with their line items — labor, parts, tires, fees, subcontracts — authorization status and totals. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/order/:orderId/service.

tools.name: shopmonkey_search_appointments
tools.title: Search appointments
tools.description: Search the appointment calendar by date range, customer, order or technician. Returns appointments with their customer. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/appointment/search.

startFrom.description: Appointments starting at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

startTo.description: Appointments starting at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

endFrom.description: Appointments ending at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

endTo.description: Appointments ending at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

orderId.description: Only appointments linked to this order.

technicians.description: Only appointments assigned to these technician (user) ids.

includeUnassigned.description: With technicians, also include unassigned appointments.

sort.description: Sort by start date. Default asc.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_search_inventory_parts
tools.title: Search inventory parts
tools.description: Search the parts inventory — name, part number, SKU, quantity on hand/available/reserved, retail and wholesale cost in cents, bin location, brand and vendor. Filter e.g. {"sku": "ABC-123"}. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/inventory_part/search.

where.description: Filter object applied server-side, keyed by field name, e.g. {"lastName": "Smith"} or {"createdDate": {"gte": "2026-01-01"}}.

orderBy.description: Sort instructions keyed by field name, e.g. {"createdDate": "desc"}.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_list_canned_services
tools.title: List canned services
tools.description: List the shop's canned services (reusable job templates like 'Oil change') with their labor, parts and fees and total in cents. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/canned_service.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_list_workflow_statuses
tools.title: List workflow statuses
tools.description: List the workflow statuses (the columns of the shop's work-order board) with their position. Use the id to move an order with shopmonkey_update_order. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/workflow_status.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the shop's users (service writers, technicians, admins) — the ids to use for technicians and service writers. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/user.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

tools.name: shopmonkey_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer (a person) or a fleet account. Add an email afterwards with shopmonkey_add_customer_email. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/customer.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US or CA.

externalId.description: Your own id for this customer in another system.

locationId.description: The shop location id (see shopmonkey_get_current_user for the key's own location).

tools.name: shopmonkey_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Update a customer's name, address, note or preferences. Only the fields you pass are sent. Shopmonkey: PUT /v3/customer/:id.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US or CA.

externalId.description: Your own id for this customer in another system.

tools.name: shopmonkey_add_customer_email
tools.title: Add an email to a customer
tools.description: Add an email address to an existing customer, optionally as their primary address. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/customer/:id/email.

primary.description: Make this the customer's primary email.

subscribed.description: Whether the customer receives messages at this address.

locationId.description: The shop location id (see shopmonkey_get_current_user for the key's own location).

annotations.title: Add an email to a customer

tools.name: shopmonkey_create_vehicle
tools.title: Create a vehicle
tools.description: Create a vehicle, optionally attached to a customer. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/vehicle.

size.description: LightDuty (cars, light trucks), HeavyDuty, or Other.

locationId.description: The shop location id (see shopmonkey_get_current_user for the key's own location).

tools.name: shopmonkey_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Open a new work order (it starts as an estimate) for a customer and vehicle. Add services and labor with shopmonkey_add_service. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/order.

customerId.description: The customer the order is for.

dueDate.description: When the vehicle is promised, ISO 8601 date-time.

serviceWriterId.description: User id of the service writer.

workflowStatusId.description: Workflow status (board column) id — see shopmonkey_list_workflow_statuses.

locationId.description: The shop location id (see shopmonkey_get_current_user for the key's own location).

tools.name: shopmonkey_update_order
tools.title: Update an order
tools.description: Update a work order — move it to another workflow status, change its status (Estimate, RepairOrder, Invoice), edit complaint/recommendation, due date, service writer, or archive it. Only the fields you pass are sent. Shopmonkey: PUT /v3/order/:id.

customerId.description: The customer the order is for.

dueDate.description: When the vehicle is promised, ISO 8601 date-time.

serviceWriterId.description: User id of the service writer.

workflowStatusId.description: Workflow status (board column) id — see shopmonkey_list_workflow_statuses.

tools.name: shopmonkey_create_appointment
tools.title: Book an appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment on the shop calendar, optionally for a customer, vehicle and order and assigned to technicians. Confirmation/reminder messages are only sent if you ask. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/appointment.

name.description: What the appointment is for, e.g. 'Oil change'.

technicianIds.description: User ids of the assigned technicians.

sendConfirmation.description: Send the customer a confirmation now.

sendReminder.description: Send the customer a reminder before the appointment.

tools.name: shopmonkey_update_appointment
tools.title: Update or reschedule an appointment
tools.description: Change an existing appointment — move it (new startDate/endDate), rename it, change its note, color, technicians, customer, vehicle or linked order, or set its confirmation status. Only the fields you pass are sent, so nothing is duplicated. Find the id with shopmonkey_search_appointments. Shopmonkey: PUT /v3/appointment/:id.

appointmentId.description: The appointment id (for one occurrence of a recurring appointment, its recurringExceptionId).

note.description: Notes for the appointment (replaces the old note).

technicianIds.description: User ids of the assigned technicians (replaces the old list).

recurringAppointmentUpdateScope.description: For a recurring appointment: change only this occurrence (Current) or this and all later ones.

sendRescheduleConfirmation.description: Send the customer a message about the new time.

useEmail.description: Use email for messages to the customer.

useSMS.description: Use SMS for messages to the customer.

tools.name: shopmonkey_delete_appointment
tools.title: Delete (cancel) an appointment
tools.description: WRITE — removes an appointment from the shop calendar. To move it instead, use shopmonkey_update_appointment. Without confirm it only previews: it reads the appointment and deletes nothing. Show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm: true. After the delete the appointment is read again to verify it is gone. Shopmonkey: DELETE /v3/appointment/:id.

confirm.description: true = delete now. Omit or false = preview only (nothing is deleted).

tools.name: shopmonkey_add_service
tools.title: Add a service (job) to an order
tools.description: Add a new service (job) to a work order, e.g. 'Road Call', optionally with labor lines (name, hours, hourly rate in cents). The service is created first, then each labor line is added to it. Find the order id with shopmonkey_find_order_by_number. To add labor to a service that exists, use shopmonkey_add_labor. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/order/:orderId/service, then POST /v3/order/:orderId/service/:serviceId/labor.

labors.description: Labor lines to add to the new service.

rateCents.description: Hourly rate in cents, e.g. 12500 for $125.00/h. Omit to use rateId or the shop's default rate.

rateId.description: A saved labor rate id instead of rateCents.

technicianId.description: User id of the technician doing the work.

annotations.title: Add a service (job) to an order

tools.name: shopmonkey_add_labor
tools.title: Add a labor line to a service
tools.description: Add a labor line (name, hours, hourly rate in cents, technician) to a service on a work order. Get the service id with shopmonkey_list_order_services; to start a new service, use shopmonkey_add_service. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/order/:orderId/service/:serviceId/labor.

rateCents.description: Hourly rate in cents, e.g. 12500 for $125.00/h. Omit to use rateId or the shop's default rate.

rateId.description: A saved labor rate id instead of rateCents.

technicianId.description: User id of the technician doing the work.

annotations.title: Add a labor line to a service

tools.name: shopmonkey_send_estimate
tools.title: Send an estimate for customer authorization
tools.description: Share a work order's estimate through Shopmonkey messaging by Email, SMS or All. Reads the order and customer, enables customer authorization on the order, then creates an Order share message. This requests the customer's approval; it does not record approval. Supply the message text. Contact ids must belong to the order's customer; omitted ids use the order's selected contact, the primary contact, or the only contact. Returns Shopmonkey's message and delivery statuses (creation does not guarantee delivery). Invoiced or deleted orders cannot be sent. Shopmonkey: GET /v3/order/:id, GET /v3/customer/:id, PUT /v3/order/:id, POST /v3/message.

channel.description: Send by email, SMS, or both.

annotations.title: Send an estimate for customer authorization

tools.name: shopmonkey_add_part
tools.title: Add a part to a work order service
tools.description: Add a part line to an existing service on a work order. Use shopmonkey_list_order_services for serviceId and shopmonkey_search_inventory_parts for inventoryPartId. Prices are per unit in cents; quantity may be fractional. Inventory reservation and reduction happen only if explicitly requested. Returns data.part with the new part id. This does not create or fulfill a vendor purchase order: those writes are not documented in Shopmonkey's public API. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/order/:orderId/service/:serviceId/part.

purchaseOrderPartId.description: Link an existing purchase order part; does not create a PO.

reserved.description: Reserve inventory for this line (default false).

annotations.title: Add a part to a work order service
